name: Hangry Mama Bar & Kitchen
street: Bottom Floor Opposite of Streetside, 803 Kamehameha Hwy Suite #116
description: Hangry Mama Bar and Kitchen is a lively karaoke venue known for its friendly atmosphere and fusion cuisine. The place offers a full-service bar with a great sound system that makes singing sessions enjoyable. The staff is attentive and welcoming, creating a fun environment suitable for friends and families alike. With karaoke available daily, it’s a perfect spot to unwind, sing your heart out, and enjoy good food and drinks in a relaxed setting.
